versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei抖音作品内容调研 skill.
- Supports keyword search, creator post retrieval, video comment extraction, and real-time Douyin trending list for structured content research.
- Triggered by both explicit queries (e.g. "抖音热搜", "博主最近发了什么") and generalized research questions.
- Strict environment variable token handling with clear error reporting and no hardcoded credentials.
- Outputs structured JSON, with logs saved and comprehensive error handling.
- Limited to public Douyin data only; does not support publishing, video editing, downloads, or use on other platforms.
